sections.what: Brings in the test tools and the API functions the tests cover, including job reading and cancelling, programme and scene reading, reports, and saved models.

sections.name: programme paging client (part 1)
sections.title: Tests for addresses and safe retries
sections.what: Checks that paging addresses carry the right offsets and project filter, that an error names the failed address and status, and that a dropped read is repeated with waits while a dropped cancel is not repeated.
sections.why: Likely reason: these rules stop wrong data pages and duplicate changes. The group is named for the programme client, but it also tests job reads.
sections.watch_out: The retry tests count exact calls and exact waits, so changing the retry settings means updating these tests.

sections.name: programme paging client (part 2)
sections.title: Tests for timeouts and no regeneration
sections.what: Checks that a dropped read gives up after the last retry, that a server error is not retried, that status requests stop after 15 seconds, and that saved scene and model reads stop after 120 seconds. It also checks that these reads are never sent as changes.
sections.why: Likely reason: the timeouts stop the screen from waiting forever without cutting off valid large jobs, and reads must never regenerate data.
sections.watch_out: A stalled saved model can take up to two minutes before the error appears, and these tests lock that in.

sections.name: programme paging client (part 3)
sections.title: Tests for slow saved models and user stop
sections.what: Checks that a saved model body can take 20 seconds without failing, that the 120 second limit applies with no retry, and that the user's stop request cancels a saved model read right away.
sections.why: Likely reason: saved models can be large, so these tests keep the limit from cutting off a valid download.
sections.watch_out: The stop test looks for exact message wording, so changing that text breaks the test.
